item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Saola will move across the northeastern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow, and move towards the coast of eastern Guangdong. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, there are still uncertainties in Saola's subsequent movement and intensity. It may make landfall over Guangdong, or move westwards along the coastal waters of Guangdong. Under the influence of Saola, it will be windy with squally showers and swells over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and over the weekend. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Haikui will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days.
